snippet.title: Is winning the premier league worth it? #investing #premierleague #football
snippet.description:
Arsenal won the 2025/26 Premier League 
The prestige is huge.
The financial gap is surprisingly small.

The difference between winning the title and finishing 8th was just £36.1m.

That doesn’t even cover the cost of signing one good quality player.

The champions can benefit from higher merchandise sales, stronger sponsorship leverage and global brand growth.

Even with the increase in revenue, the risk of investing in elite players is significant

That’s why Premier League clubs don’t just chase trophies. They prioritise:

• Champions League / European qualification
• Stability and avoiding relegation battles
• Commercial growth
• Stadium expansion
• Player trading upside

In football finance, the league table matters.
But the business model matters just as much.

Would you rather win the title for glory, or build for long-term profits?

Source: The Athletic / Financial Intelligence
Follow @hassanomics

#premierleague #uk #business #money #investment

Portugal’s final Group K clash against Colombia isn’t just another group-stage game… it could determine their ENTIRE World Cup journey. 🤯

🇨🇴 Colombia only need a DRAW to finish top of the group.

🇵🇹 Portugal MUST WIN to claim 1st place. That one result could completely reshape the knockout bracket.

⸻

🟢 IF PORTUGAL BEAT COLOMBIA (Route 1):

➡️ ROUND OF 32: 🇭🇷 Croatia / 🇬🇭 Ghana

➡️ ROUND OF 16: 🇨🇭 Switzerland / 🇮🇷 Iran

➡️ QUARTER-FINAL: 🇦🇷 Argentina / 🇪🇬 Egypt / 🇦🇺 Australia

➡️ SEMI-FINAL: 🏴 England / 🇧🇷 Brazil / 🇳🇴 Norway / 🇲🇽 Mexico

⸻

🔴 IF PORTUGAL DRAW OR LOSE TO COLOMBIA (Route 2):

➡️ ROUND OF 32: 🇭🇷 Croatia / 🇬🇭 Ghana

➡️ ROUND OF 16: 🇪🇸 Spain / 🇦🇹 Austria / 🇩🇿 Algeria

➡️ QUARTER-FINAL: 🇧🇪 Belgium / 🇰🇷 South Korea / 🇺🇸 USA / 🇧🇦 Bosnia & Herzegovina

➡️ SEMI-FINAL: 🇫🇷 France / 🇳🇱 Netherlands / 🇩🇪 Germany / 🇲🇦 Morocco

⸻

😳 Either way, there are NO easy games.

One route could feature a blockbuster showdown with Lionel Messi’s Argentina in the quarter-finals before potentially facing England or Brazil.

The other could force Portugal through a brutal European gauntlet of Spain, followed by Belgium, before a possible semi-final against France, Germany or the Netherlands. 😬🔥

Everything is still in Portugal’s hands… but 90 minutes against Colombia could decide whether Ronaldo’s dream of lifting the World Cup becomes much harder. 🏆🐐
